description: Counts Claude Code token usage per model and session into .claude/hooks/token-stats.json, plus a skill that reports it.

hooks.command: $v = 0; try { $v = [int]((node --version) -replace '^v(\d+)\..*$', '$1') } catch {}; if ($v -lt 18) { Write-Output 'Noesis plugin token-usage: Node.js 18 or later was not found on PATH, so its hooks will not run. Tell the user to install the Node.js LTS from https://nodejs.org or with winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS and then fully restart the Claude app. Do not install it without the user approval.' }
